description: Today in the Kodiak Fisheries Debate, lifelong Alaskan and former permit holder Mary Peltola distinguished herself as the only candidate who will fight for Alaska fisheries as Dan Sullivan failed to defend his anti-fish record, ties to anti-Alaska special interests, and factory trawling industry campaign contributions.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Alaskans for Mary
title: Mary Peltola Champions Lifelong Fight for Fisheries at Kodiak Fisheries Debate, Crushes Dan Sullivan & His Lower 48 Anti-Fish Agenda - Mary Peltola | Fish, Family, Freedom.
